title: ChipBlocks buses manifest
description: Single source of truth for on-chip bus protocols used to wire blocks together at the system level. Per ADR-005, this file is authored at repo root. Distinct from the per-port bus types in ADR-001's BusType enum: those are wire-level (audio-s8, data-u8, etc.); this manifest enumerates higher-level protocols (Wishbone, AXI-lite, APB). Phase 0 is an empty array; first row (wishbone-classic) lands in Sprint 26 to support the S29 packaged CPU.

source.description: URL or paper citation for the bus spec.

license.description: License of the spec. Public-domain (Wishbone) is the most permissive option.
